Indian Cricket Teams Face Player Injuries Ahead of Sri Lanka Series

Ahead of the Sri Lanka Test series, the Indian cricket team is facing significant player availability concerns due to injuries. Jasprit Bumrah and Sudeep Sudarshan have already been ruled out. Washington Sundar's participation is also in doubt due to an injury. Meanwhile, Sri Lanka has announced its 16-player squad for the Test series, with their captain issuing a warning about the pitch conditions, which are expected to favor spin bowling. Separately, former player Harbhajan Singh advised coach Gautam Gambhir to finalize the ODI World Cup squad months in advance.
